sidebar.title: Interactive Runtime
sidebar.descriptionLocked: {{kind}} uses separate saves; events do not write back to the novel Canon.
sidebar.descriptionUnlocked: NPCs, TTRPG sessions, and character chats share separate saves. Events here do not write back to the novel Canon.

detail.emptyLocked: Create a {{kind}} session to start a new interactive save.
detail.emptyUnlocked: Create a sandbox session to validate the shared runtime.
detail.deleteMessage: All events and checkpoints for this session will be deleted; child branches are kept and unlinked from the parent session.

ttrpg.heading: Solo Campaign Host
ttrpg.description: Player actions, deterministic checks, and AI GM narration are recorded as replayable turns; AI does not directly mutate runtime state.

campaign.heading: Long-Term Campaign
campaign.description: Campaign summaries, quests, and NPC schedules follow the runtime event stream and can continue across branched sessions.
campaign.summaryPlaceholder: Record plot progress, unresolved conflicts, and pacing notes that should persist across scenes and sessions.
campaign.clockNote: Advancing time recalculates quest deadlines and NPC schedules against the same runtime clock.
campaign.questIdPlaceholder: Quest ID (to update the same quest)
campaign.scheduleIdPlaceholder: Schedule ID (to update the same schedule)

deterministic.heading: Deterministic Actions
deterministic.narrativePlaceholder: Record narratives exclusive to this session…

narrativeState.heading: Current Narrative State
narrativeState.description: Includes narratives inherited from the parent session; the log below only lists events appended in this session.
